description: This file defines the Manufacturer model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for retrieving manufacturer details, listing manufacturers, and obtaining layout IDs from the database.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing manufacturer data, including retrieving individual manufacturer info, multiple manufacturers, and layout IDs.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific manufacturer record by its ID from the database, including associated description and store data.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves multiple manufacturer records based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, with caching support.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific manufacturer.
